mainEntity.name: What is an AI thought leadership agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI thought leadership agency positions a technical founder as a named authority in their category: placing op-eds in tier-1 outlets, securing podcast bookings on indexed shows, and building a published record that journalists, analysts and AI engines cite. It is built for AI founders who have a credible point of view but no structured PR operation to get it in front of the right rooms. Shilika Jain runs this directly as a fractional operator for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI thought leadership PR cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior operator handling positioning, op-ed writing and placement runs $5K–$12K per month, which removes the account-team overhead baked into a traditional agency retainer of $15K–$45K/month. A standalone launch sprint, covering a positioning audit, two to three placed pieces and a podcast tour, runs $15K–$40K over six to eight weeks. Pricing depends on the volume of output and the tier of outlets targeted.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets and podcasts can you actually place a founder in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 tech and AI: Forbes, Wired, TechCrunch, AI Magazine, VentureBeat. Crypto-native where relevant: CoinDesk, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks. Podcasts: shows with 10K to 200K listeners whose episodes are transcribed and indexed. Regional: Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA), Tech in Asia. Every outlet list is built on a real news angle and a direct editor relationship, not a press release wire.

mainEntity.name: What is the process and how long does it take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first two weeks are positioning: a read of your existing footprint, a category thesis, and the opinion territory worth claiming. Weeks three to six are output: op-ed drafting, direct editor pitches and podcast booking. First placements typically land within four to eight weeks of kick-off. The compounding effect, where earlier placements generate inbound media requests and AI citations, builds over three to six months of sustained work.

Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your current footprint and the category angle worth pursuing, or book a 30-minute call and we will map it live. No deck, no account-team intro call.
